text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Generative AI and photo data used without recorded review","detail":"The proposal generates instructions from past pickup photos, which involves generative AI and potentially personal data (people, faces, license plates in photos). No legal, privacy, or AI policy review is recorded; only a data-provision dependency is listed.","evidence_quote":"Generate store-specific pickup instructions from past pickup photos and show them in the driver app.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record privacy/data and generative AI policy review (photo consent, PII scrubbing, content quality review) before launch."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Non-random volunteer-market assignment and short duration","detail":"Markets are self-selected by volunteering managers and compared with remaining markets, introducing selection bias rather than randomization. Duration of 3 weeks is acceptable for the 14-day minimum, but the 10-week success timeframe is not covered. The MDE of 1 point is also inconsistent with the $0.15 target (about 2%), so the test is underpowered for the claimed effect.","evidence_quote":"Run a pilot in the markets whose managers volunteer and compare against the remaining markets. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomly assign stores or markets (with matched pairs or stratification), size the test to detect the targeted ~2% cost change, and align duration with the metric timeframe."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required guardrails absent for driver app/pickup change","detail":"The change affects driver pickup behavior, yet only Delivery Defect Rate is guarded. Pickup time/dwell time, delivery time or late rate, and driver experience or support contacts are not guarded, and the stated problem is about store associate time.","evidence_quote":"Delivery Defect Rate: stop if it rises by more than 0.2 points.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as pickup/dwell time, on-time delivery rate, driver support contact rate, and driver satisfaction."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Cost per delivery baseline and problem claim lack source","detail":"The $7.40 baseline is stated as fact without a source. The causal link between lost drivers and cost is also not quantified, and the problem source is just a survey with no magnitude.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: from $7.40 to $7.25 within 10 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the source and period for the $7.40 baseline and quantify how much of cost is attributable to pickup-counter confusion."}]}
